title: Run any key
anywhere
lead: Generate, deploy, and operate keys across any environment. MPC, HSM, TEE or offline. Cloud, hybrid, or fully on-premises.

entries.title: Born distributed, never whole
entries.body: With MPC, keys are created as separated shares, from independent entropy, assembled nowhere. No seed phrase, no master secret.

entries.title: Every technology, every curve
entries.body: MPC, HSM, TEE, offline, combinable in one setup. Every curve (ECDSA, EdDSA, Schnorr, STARK) and derivation (BIP 34, SLIP 10).

entries.title: Cryptography we build ourselves
entries.body: Our open-source MPC implementations (CGGMP24, FROST) are peer-reviewed and independently audited. Our protocol (KU25) is patent-pending.

entries.title: Recovery without trust
entries.body: Multi-layered backups, offline storage, third-party DR, and break-glass export via PKCS#11. Your keys outlive your agreement with us.
